catalog.description: C15 persistence probe capability (idempotent, operator provided)
catalog.name: c15_probe_capability

catalog.description: Persist a typed AI-world cognition using the unified EvidenceSet + Claim + Dependency path.
catalog.name: commit_ai_world_claim

catalog.description: Persist a revisable AI cognition Claim grounded in pinned world evidence. This capability cannot create Observation facts.
catalog.name: commit_claim

catalog.description: During an active periodic review, persist a model-authored operation experience grounded in pinned real case refs.
catalog.name: commit_operation_experience

catalog.description: Inspect multiple pinned Claims side by side with their evidence/status; the model decides meaning.
catalog.name: compare_claims

catalog.description: Register future attention as a constrained mechanical Observation watch. The Resident chooses the routing class: interrupt wakes cognition immediately and may allow user delivery after Resident judgment; background waits for short mechanical batching, invokes cognition, and is silent to the user by default; review_queue does not invoke the Resident immediately and carries matched evidence into Periodic Review. Choose the class from the future-attention intent and current runtime facts; Core does not infer urgency for you. Do not encode emotion, intent, diagnosis, or other semantic conclusions in the mechanical predicate.
catalog.name: create_attention_watch

catalog.description: Create a concrete evidence-grounded Task, optionally under a current Goal.
catalog.name: create_task

catalog.description: Read exact pinned raw dialogue behind a same-session round summary, or an explicit turn range. Round summaries are indexes, not truth.
catalog.name: drill_down_conversation

catalog.description: Request a broader bounded world recall after the initial recommendation/search was insufficient.
catalog.name: expand_recall

catalog.description: Focus retrieval on one known Entity id without semantic reinterpretation.
catalog.name: focus_entity

catalog.description: Follow one-hop explicit Relation objects connected to a world object.
catalog.name: follow_relation

catalog.description: Form a revisable Event candidate from pinned world evidence. The model supplies the event meaning; code only validates provenance.
catalog.name: form_event

catalog.description: Inspect a pinned real Action Outcome and its Action reference.
catalog.name: inspect_outcome

catalog.description: Read one pinned or latest world object by object id.
catalog.name: inspect_world_object

catalog.description: List Resident-authored active attention watches. Watches contain only mechanical future-match predicates; the Resident interprets meaning after Wake.
catalog.name: list_attention_watches

catalog.description: List same-session continuity summary windows on demand. Use this when token budgeting omitted summary content from the cockpit.
catalog.name: list_conversation_summaries

catalog.description: List current registered dimension definitions so the resident AI can check whether an existing observation axis already serves the need.
catalog.name: list_dimensions

catalog.description: Create a PROPOSED external Action for a RUNNING Task. This capability never executes the side effect and cannot authorize itself.
catalog.name: propose_action

catalog.description: Register a new evidence-grounded AI-mutable cognitive policy. Only real user/world result evidence is accepted; hard boundaries cannot be created by the resident AI.
catalog.name: propose_cognitive_policy

catalog.description: Submit an evidence-grounded candidate observation axis. The system validates structure; the model supplies semantic rationale.
catalog.name: propose_dimension

catalog.description: Create a durable Entity anchor from pinned same-world evidence. The resident supplies identity meaning; Core enforces explicit entity_key and provenance.
catalog.name: propose_entity

catalog.description: Create an evidence-grounded Goal proposal in the unified world. A proposal does not grant external-action authorization.
catalog.name: propose_goal

catalog.description: Read current evidence-grounded AI cognition across user understanding, relationship, self, intent, strategy, boundary, personality and calibration. Displays valid_time, unknown_items, and counter_evidence_summary.
catalog.name: read_ai_world

catalog.description: Read the current mechanical BACKGROUND_DAY budget and durable usage. This reports policy caps, Wake/model-call usage and remaining capacity only; it does not decide which future fact is important.
catalog.name: read_background_budget

catalog.description: Read current versioned R6 policy records from the unified world.
catalog.name: read_cognitive_policies

catalog.description: Read current Goals, Tasks and proposed/executed Actions from the unified world. This is a read-only planning view.
catalog.name: read_execution_world

catalog.description: Read a bounded page of the evidence anchors selected for the currently active periodic review. Available only during review.
catalog.name: read_periodic_review_anchors

catalog.description: Refresh the compact L0 world-map directory. Returns dimension identity, mechanical activity/count metadata and expansion capability names only; it does not return dimension payloads or semantic conclusions.
catalog.name: read_world_map

catalog.description: Record what communication style was used and the real user/world reaction. This records evidence only and does not choose a future style.
catalog.name: record_communication_experience

catalog.description: Observe several parallel dimensions in one time window without turning co-occurrence into a causal conclusion.
catalog.name: request_all_dimensions_projection

catalog.description: Retract the current Claim using pinned contrary/correcting evidence and propagate review-required state to dependents.
catalog.name: retract_claim

catalog.description: Retrieve an exact Observation fact by id/revision for evidence drill-down.

catalog.description: Create a forward-only new revision of the current Claim and mark dependent cognition review-required.

catalog.description: Append a new revision of the current Entity identity anchor using pinned evidence.

catalog.description: Forward-append a rollback to an earlier policy version using pinned evidence.

catalog.description: Search same-session round-summary indexes by topic/text, then drill down to exact pinned raw dialogue when precision is needed.

catalog.name: search_world

catalog.description: Move the current dimension revision through a legal lifecycle transition using pinned evidence and an AI-supplied reason.
catalog.name: transition_dimension

catalog.description: Forward-revise/resolve/reject/merge/split the current Event using pinned evidence.
catalog.name: transition_event

catalog.description: Move the current Goal revision through a legal evidence-backed state transition.
catalog.name: transition_goal

catalog.description: Move the current Task revision through a legal state transition. Terminal transitions obey the Task's explicit completion mode: WORLD_EVIDENCE uses pinned durable evidence; ACTION_OUTCOME requires a real authorized Action-linked Outcome; MIXED requires both.

catalog.description: Append an evidence-grounded value revision to an already-registered AI-mutable cognitive policy. Cannot create or loosen hard boundaries.
